[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] '''Jarroth''' of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] patrolled the [[Virgillia system/Legends|Virgillia system]], as [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the ''[[Stormwind]]'', during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
